spans.text: [23] AR: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا EN: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.

folded.id: of allah|will|drink
folded.subject: of Allah
folded.object: drink

spans.text: [6] AR: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا EN: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

folded.id: so allah|will|protect them from the evil of that day and give them radiance and happiness
folded.subject: So Allah
folded.object: protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

spans.text: [11] AR: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا EN: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

folded.id: so he|who|wills may take to his lord a way
folded.subject: so he
folded.object: wills may take to his Lord a way

spans.text: [29] AR: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا EN: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

folded.id: the immediate|and|leave behind them a grave day
folded.subject: the immediate
folded.object: leave behind them a grave Day

spans.text: [27] AR: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا EN: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.

folded.id: the inhabitants|will|be green garments of fine silk and brocade
folded.subject: the inhabitants
folded.object: be green garments of fine silk and brocade

spans.text: [21] AR: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا EN: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade.

folded.id: the righteous|will|drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of kafur
folded.subject: the righteous
folded.object: drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur

spans.text: [5] AR: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا EN: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,

folded.id: their lord|will|give them a purifying drink
folded.subject: their Lord
folded.object: give them a purifying drink

spans.text: And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

folded.id: there|will|circulate among them young boys made eternal
folded.subject: There
folded.object: circulate among them young boys made eternal

spans.text: [19] AR: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا EN: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal.

folded.id: they|will|be] reclining therein on adorned couches
folded.subject: They
folded.object: be] reclining therein on adorned couches

spans.text: [13] AR: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا EN: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches.
They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.

folded.id: they|will|make it gush forth in force [and abundance]
folded.subject: they
folded.object: make it gush forth in force [and abundance]

spans.text: [6] AR: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا EN: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

folded.id: this is|a|reminder
folded.subject: this is
folded.object: reminder

spans.text: [29] AR: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا EN: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

folded.id: this|is|for you a reward
folded.subject: this
folded.object: for you a reward

spans.text: [22] AR: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا EN: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

folded.id: to him|and|exalt him a long [part of the] night
folded.subject: to Him
folded.object: exalt Him a long [part of the] night

spans.text: [26] AR: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا EN: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.

folded.id: upon man|a|period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
folded.subject: upon man
folded.object: period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا EN: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

folded.id: vows and|fear|a day whose evil will be widespread
folded.subject: vows and
folded.object: a Day whose evil will be widespread

spans.text: [7] AR: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا EN: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.

folded.id: we have|created|them and strengthened their forms
folded.subject: We have
folded.object: them and strengthened their forms

spans.text: [28] AR: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا EN: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

folded.id: we|can|change their likenesses with [complete] alteration
folded.subject: We
folded.object: change their likenesses with [complete] alteration

spans.text: [28] AR: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا EN: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

folded.id: we|created|man from a sperm-drop mixture that we may try him
folded.subject: We
folded.object: man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him

spans.text: [2] AR: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا EN: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.

folded.id: we|fear|from our lord a day austere and distressful
folded.subject: We
folded.object: from our Lord a Day austere and distressful

spans.text: [10] AR: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا EN: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

folded.id: we|feed|you only for the countenance of allah
folded.subject: We
folded.object: you only for the countenance of Allah

spans.text: [9] AR: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا EN: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah.

folded.id: we|guided|him to the way
folded.subject: We
folded.object: him to the way

spans.text: [3] AR: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا EN: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

folded.id: we|have|prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze
folded.subject: We
folded.object: prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze

spans.text: [4] AR: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا EN: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

folded.id: we|wish|not from you reward or gratitude
folded.subject: We
folded.object: not from you reward or gratitude

spans.text: We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

folded.id: which they|have|determined the measure
folded.subject: which they
folded.object: determined the measure

spans.text: [16] AR: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا EN: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

folded.id: whom he|wills|into his mercy
folded.subject: whom He
folded.object: into His mercy

spans.text: [31] AR: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا EN: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

folded.id: within paradise|named|salsabeel
folded.subject: within Paradise
folded.object: Salsabeel

spans.text: [18] AR: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا EN: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.

folded.id: you|will|see pleasure and great dominion
folded.subject: you
folded.object: see pleasure and great dominion

spans.text: [20] AR: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا EN: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.

folded.id: your lord|and|do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever]
folded.subject: your Lord
folded.object: do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever]

spans.text: [24] AR: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا EN: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].

folded.id: your lord|morning|and evening
folded.subject: your Lord
folded.object: and evening

spans.text: [25] AR: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا EN: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
